scope: Actual Chromium/Metal r3d canvas. Diagnostic service-field approach and bounded ring/key approaches; ordinary E/W/R input performs the optional journey. Actual page reload + Continue tests persistence. Normal and reduced motion; no shader or module substitution. This is local route-mechanism evidence, not a full earned campaign or completed combat.

the optional personal door is available
personal entry: ordinary E opens the door

frame.objective: The loose lead runs from the boy’s chair, through the service door.

checks.name: hall has the real child and continuous physical strand
normal movement works without bell-field ejection
walk close enough to see the child and loose lead
walk through the centre aisle to the voluntary onward opening
the service opening remains voluntarily walkable
walk the tape connector on ordinary safe ground
walk to the contractor from behind
the visible contractor exposes the recorder action

listening archives the authored recording
